title: Rojer Mathew v. South Indian Bank Ltd.

content.caseIdentity: Rojer Mathew v. South Indian Bank Ltd., (2020) 6 SCC 1
content.facts: The Court examined a common statutory framework for tribunal appointments and service conditions.
questionsBeforeCourt: How should efficiency be balanced with independence in tribunals?
What constitutional constraints govern tribunal administration?
Whether tribunal service conditions and appointments could be structured in a manner inconsistent with judicial independence.
content.ratioDecidendi: Efficiency and specialisation cannot be pursued at the expense of institutional independence and constitutional adjudicatory standards.
content.holding: The Court found constitutional defects in the framework.
content.relevance: Use for modern limits on tribunal design.
